# Avec Anima

> Avec Anima is an underground house and tech house night on the Isle of Man, running events at venues across the island — from Douglas clubs to one-off nights in the glens.

Contact: hello@avecanima.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://kylemckee358-ai.github.io/avec-anima/): Next upcoming events, featured live set and merch
- [Events](https://kylemckee358-ai.github.io/avec-anima/events.html): Full list of upcoming and previous events
- [Music](https://kylemckee358-ai.github.io/avec-anima/music.html): Live sets on YouTube and mixes on SoundCloud

## Upcoming events

- None announced yet — check the events page.
